item.title: KSUR off air from 10:30am–5:00pm during heatwave
item.description: KSPB’s sister station in Big Sur, KSUR, will be off the air between 10:30 AM and 5:00 PM during the current heatwave due to high temperatures at its transmitter location, which is not air conditioned.

item.title: KSUR back to normal 24×7 operations (3/22/2026)
item.description: KSPB’s sister station in Big Sur, KSUR, has resumed fulltime operation now that temperatures have cooled and its transmitter equipment is not overheating.
